name: Hearth
description: A warm, rich mature male narrator in his fifties: smooth baritone, calm and steady, like a trusted storyteller by a fire.

name: Willow
description: A warm mature female narrator in her forties: rich, clear alto, unhurried and gentle, with quiet authority.

name: Tide
description: A weathered middle-aged man, a fisherman from Galilee: warm, gravelly baritone, slow and deliberate, slightly hoarse, kind.

name: Oak
description: An elderly man in his late seventies: deep, slightly raspy and unsteady voice, dignified and wise, speaking slowly.

name: Sage
description: An elderly woman in her eighties: thin, gentle, slightly trembling voice, warm and joyful, full of wisdom.

name: Ember
description: A young man in his early twenties: bright, clear tenor, eager and sincere, a little impulsive, full of energy.

name: Lark
description: A young woman in her early twenties: bright, clear, light soprano voice, lively and expressive, quick to laugh.

name: Dove
description: A woman in her thirties: soft, warm mezzo-soprano, tender and hushed, deeply caring, with quiet strength.

name: Iron
description: A man in his forties used to command: deep, resonant bass voice, measured and authoritative, controlled and serious.

name: Frost
description: A refined official in his fifties: crisp, precise, cool baritone with a slightly nasal, aristocratic edge, calculating and condescending.

name: Wren
description: A quick-witted merchant in his thirties: slightly nasal tenor, speaks fast and precisely, a bit anxious, clever and self-deprecating.

name: Flint
description: A passionate man in his thirties: intense, slightly hoarse baritone with sharp edges, fiery and urgent, restless.

name: Stone
description: A burly laborer in his forties: loud, rough, earthy voice, plain-spoken and blunt, with a hearty laugh.

name: Quill
description: A scholar in his sixties: soft-spoken, thoughtful, slightly breathy light voice, precise and careful with every word.

name: Ash
description: A woman in her fifties who has known hardship: low, husky alto, weary but unbroken, dry humor, strong.

name: Balm
description: A healer in her forties: calm, measured, soothing mezzo voice, steady and reassuring, never hurried.

name: Fern
description: A shy young woman of about eighteen: quiet, slightly breathy light voice, timid and hesitant, but sincere.

name: Vale
description: A fierce woman in her late twenties: strong, slightly raspy alto, bold and defiant, quick-tongued and confident.

name: Sparrow
description: A boy of about fourteen whose voice is just starting to change: curious, a little awkward, earnest and talkative.

name: Poppy
description: A girl of about eight: light, high, clear voice, innocent and curious, speaking with wonder.

name: Pip
description: A boy of about nine: high, bright voice, playful and mischievous, full of energy and questions.
